title: Customer tracks an order with a frozen price snapshot

card.i_want: to view my order's status, timeline and frozen prices
card.so_that: I can track delivery and see what I actually agreed to pay

context: An order shows a price/name/address snapshot taken at creation and is visible only to its owner; later catalog edits must not change it.

given: a customer who owns order ORD-20260507-000001 created at price 1290 THB
acceptance_criteria.when: the catalog price later changes to 999 THB and the owner opens the order
then: the status timeline and tracking number (if shipped) are shown

given: a customer who does not own the order
acceptance_criteria.when: they request the order by its number
then: access is denied with no order data disclosed
an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the order carries the customer's snapshotted shipping address
pii_fields.treatment: visible to the owner and admin only; redacted elsewhere

idempotency.justification: viewing an order is a read with no mutation

reversibility.justification: a read has nothing to reverse

authn_authz.justification: own-data-only: A must never see B's order

regulatory.justification: covered by PDPA basis already inventoried; no new regulated processing here
